title: 384 Well Plate PCR Plate with Triplicates
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Specify the number of cDNA tubes (up to 8), the number of mastermix tubes, the cDNA/mastermix volume in µL, and the P20 single‑channel pipette mount (left or right) before starting the plate setup.

steps.title: Add cDNA in triplicates
steps.instruction: Using the P20 pipette, dispense the specified cDNA volume into three consecutive wells of a column (triplicate) for each cDNA sample, moving down the column until the number of columns equals the number of mastermix tubes.

substeps.instruction: Select the P20 mount (left or right) as configured.
Dispense into the first well of the column.
Repeat dispensing into the next two wells of the same column (triplicate).
Proceed to the next column and repeat for all cDNA samples.

steps.title: Add mastermix to each column
steps.instruction: Calculate mastermix volume as 20 µL minus the cDNA volume, then using the P20 pipette add this mastermix volume to every well that already contains cDNA, ensuring each well reaches a total of 20 µL.

substeps.instruction: Add mastermix to each populated well in the column, one well at a time.
Confirm that the final volume in each well is 20 µL.
